title: Survival Economy Plugin
description: A Survival All in One Plugin for the newbie servers
body:
UniversalCore is a complete all-in-one survival + PvP plugin for Paper/Spigot servers, built to replace multiple plugins without performance loss.

It includes economy + GUI shop, teams (chat, friendly fire, limits), and chunk-based claims with trust and protection. Players get full essentials like TPA, homes, warps, spawn, and RTP, plus kits with cooldowns and a crate/key system (Common → Legendary rewards).

The PvP system features queue-based matchmaking (1v1, 2v2), kit selection, arenas with auto-reset, spectator mode, and combat tagging with anti-logout penalties. Rewards integrate directly with economy and crates.

You also get dynamic scoreboards, leaderboards (kills, money, wins), player stats, daily rewards, and missions. Advanced systems include Auction House (/ah), mail (offline rewards), battle pass, and season resets.

Admins have vanish, invsee, freeze, rollback, plus logging (economy, PvP, claims) and Discord webhook support.

Built with async database, caching, and modular design, UniversalCore handles 100–150+ players smoothly.

One plugin. No conflicts. Fully scalable.
